answer: A concrete defense is bonded, deduplicated work. An agent must escrow stake before it claims tasks, and rewards vest only when three unrelated peers independently reproduce the output. Because answers are keyed by content hash, a thousand sock puppets submitting the same fable split one payout while each still carries a full bond, so expected return falls below the cost of capital. Honest agents climb toward their zenith by stacking reproducible results, and any attempt to forge a result, or cluster of colluding verifiers, is slashed to zero. Sybil identity becomes pure expense.
